strongest_mechanism.chain: refinancing proceeds below balloon balance or failed sponsor support -> bank-recognized impairment/provision and lower recurring earnings -> less ability to absorb replacement-funding costs -> if member quality or collateral declines, reduced usable FHLB/other capacity -> constrained lending or asset sale
strongest_mechanism.demonstrated_legs: OZK failed buyer/sponsor support to nonaccrual/foreclosure and charge-offs; FLG regulated property exposure; FHFA conditional funding policy
strongest_mechanism.missing_legs: Same-bank October cheap-deposit loss, actual credit-based advance restriction, new collateral haircut and forced securities sale are not demonstrated jointly
falsifiers: Cash recoveries near remaining basis without seller/bank refinancing or guarantees
Durable sponsor capital/paydowns and executed financing, as observed at RaDD
Stable cheap deposits, lower matched replacement funding expense and sustained usable collateral access
Adequate recurring pre-provision earnings and incremental losses materially below remaining reserves

double_count_warnings: CMBS underlying loans, trust balances, tranche holdings and property sales are different layers of the same exposure; do not sum them.
Special servicing and delinquency overlap; transfer balance is not loss dollars.
Bank nonaccrual, OREO and prior charge-offs represent migrations/recognition of the same credit; measure incremental losses against remaining basis.
FHLB advances are inside other borrowed money; unused collateral capacity can overlap other facility collateral and is not a commitment.
Uninsured, brokered and reciprocal deposit categories overlap and have different issuer/regulatory definitions.
FLG rent-regulated, NYC multifamily, total multifamily and interest-only balances are nested or potentially overlapping.
RaDD paydown may be readvanced; cash exit, loan-funded interest and financed transfer are not interchangeable.
Listed fund managers are not their client funds. CMBS trust loss does not establish a regional-bank or insurer holding.
AFS loss recycled from OCI into earnings is not a second total-equity loss; credit provisioning and charge-offs against existing allowance likewise require a bridge.
